name: Scatter Plot
summary: Labelled two-metric scatter with regression line and R², median quadrants, target highlight and box-select cross-filter.
summary_zh: 带标签的双指标散点图：回归线与 R²、中位数象限、目标公司高亮、框选交叉筛选。
description_zh: 展示两个指标之间的关系，例如 EV/EBITDA 与收入增速、EV/Revenue 与 EBITDA 利润率，用于论证“估值由增长/盈利能力驱动”。每行数据是一个点（通常是一家可比公司），点旁直接标注股票代码，重叠标签自动错开或隐藏；目标公司用强调色（accent2）突出。可叠加最小二乘回归线与 R²（只用可比公司计算，排除目标公司），或以中位数/均值/指定值画象限线并在四角写象限含义。点击点或框选一组点会交叉筛选同一页的其他图表；框选缩放、Ctrl+滚轮缩放、拖动平移用于密集数据。
best_for: Positioning the target within its peer set
Any two-metric relationship with < ~60 labelled points
avoid_when: Hundreds of points that all need labels (use a heatmap or table)

label.desc: Short point label (ticker); also the cross-filter field

name.desc: Full name for the tooltip title (company); defaults to label

color.desc: Category used for colour and legend (sector, region)

target.desc: Rows where this field is true are highlighted as the target

labels.desc: Point labels: true | false | 'auto' (on up to 40 points); overlapping labels are shifted, then hidden

regression.desc: Ordinary least-squares fit across peers (target excluded) with R² label

equation.desc: Also print the fitted equation y = bx + a

quadrants.desc: null | 'median' | 'mean' | {x, y, label} — dashed quadrant lines (peer statistics exclude the target)

highlight.desc: Label / name value(s) drawn as the target; default uses the target channel

peerLabel.desc: Legend name of the single series when no colour field is set

xFormat.desc: X format code (defaults to the x field format)

yFormat.desc: Y format code (defaults to the y field format)

xTitle.desc: X axis title (defaults to the field title)

yTitle.desc: Y axis title (defaults to the field title)

tooltipFields.desc: Extra fields listed in the tooltip

brush.desc: Box-select tool that cross-filters the label field

zoom.desc: Box zoom, Ctrl + wheel zoom, drag to pan and the hover toolbar; false = static chart

interactions: Hover tooltip with both metrics (+ extra fields)
Box zoom, Ctrl + wheel zoom, drag to pan, reset
